seeker: I am looking for another job preferably in my locality and not getting yet, since last 2 months. I will find it difficult to sustain if this continues like this for other 3 months.
supporter: So it sounds like you've been struggling with finding a new job. It's never easy looking for a new job during these times. Why do you think you're having trouble?
seeker: Getting a job is not that difficult. But I try to find a job in my locality to avoid distant from family and having food issues.
supporter: It sounds like you're motivated and dealing with a lot. Is there a specific job that you had in mind or are you applying to different kinds of jobs?
seeker: Any kind of job, probably managerial. But to be in my locality since to look after my aged mom also.
supporter: It sounds like you really care to want to be close to home. Have you talked with someone locally about jobs that would allow you to stay close to home?

Belief.A: I believe staying close to my family is more important than finding a job far away, even though it limits my options.
Belief.B: I believe I should focus on finding remote work instead of limiting myself to jobs in my locality.
Belief.C: I believe that I haven't been trying hard enough to find any job, not just one in my locality.
Belief.D: I believe that searching for a job in a new field would be easier than sticking to managerial roles.

Desires.A: I want to stop working altogether and pursue a hobby.
Desires.B: I want to find a job in a different country for a new experience.
Desires.C: I want to move to a big city far from home.
Desires.D: I want to find a job in my locality to stay close to my family.

Intentions.A: I will immediately apply for international jobs to get different experiences.
Intentions.B: I will focus on starting my own business unrelated to my current skills.
Intentions.C: I will take a break from job hunting and focus on traveling instead.
Intentions.D: I will reach out to local job agencies and networking groups to explore opportunities in my area.

Emotions.A: I feel uninterested and apathetic towards finding a new job locally.
Emotions.B: I feel ecstatic and excited about the job search and the uncertainty it brings.
Emotions.C: I feel anxious and concerned about my job situation and its impact on my family's well-being.
Emotions.D: I feel completely indifferent about my employment challenges and not worried at all.

Knowledge.A: I know that I'm looking for jobs just to pass the time, without any real concern.
Knowledge.B: I know that I need to find a job close to home to support my family and be there for my mom.
Knowledge.C: I know that finding a job isn't important as long as I'm close to family.
Knowledge.D: I know that any job anywhere would be fine, regardless of my family needs.

Trust.A: I view the supporter as someone genuinely trying to understand and help my situation, so I do trust them.
Trust.B: I view the supporter as knowledgeable about job searches but less so about my personal struggles, which makes me hesitant to trust them entirely.
Trust.C: I view the supporter as someone who might not fully understand my locality concerns, so I’m unsure about trusting them completely.
Trust.D: I view the supporter as someone who seems to be pushing me in a direction I’m not comfortable with, so I don’t trust them much.

correct_action:
seeker: I have been talking to some people who my friends knows also. They show interest but cannot help me on the issue. Surely they will refer to some people. But it will take some time.
supporter: Stay motivated. If one opportunity doesn't get your desired response you may be even closer to finding the right job for you. Keep pushing on and know that if one opportunity doesn't work out a positive attitude will make all the difference. Just because you haven't found one yet doesn't mean you won't. 
seeker: Thanks for making confidence. I feel relaxed. I believe this will surely be a chance to find myself and get a better opportunity to be relieved from my previous difficulties. Only GOD should have forced me this way, I believe.
supporter: Your faith is healthy and gives you purpose. Similarly you have to believe that the dots will connect in your favor. Maybe you can't connect them looking forward, but looking backwards you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future.
distractors:
supporter: Hi, can I help you today?
seeker: I have had my babu for 15 years and have to give him up.  He is a parrot and so used to me.
supporter: I am so sorry to hear that. You have probably become very attached after that long, I can imagine.
seeker: Yes, I am worried that he wont be taken care of.  I am worried that he wont be happy. I cook for him and take him outside.  I grow fruit so he can eat it.

seeker: Hello
supporter: Hello! How can I help you today?
seeker: I am anxious about an upcoming test.
supporter: It's normal to feel nervous whenever we have an important assessment coming. I myself would always be really anxious whenever I had any finals back in college.

supporter: That's great, you have an awesome partner. I'd recommend spending time outdoor. Getting coop up for too long indoor is damaging to your mental state
seeker: It is very challenging as they both have complex special needs. It's hard to find time and energy to operate the household in between.
supporter: Have you considered hiring caretaker?
seeker: Thank you. Yes, I haven't been out to check on the veggie garden today. That usually gives me an opportunity to calm my mind. Unfortunately, I am not in a position to do so. There is nobody that my son would be comfortable with. But we are trying to implement some respite soon.

ctx: supporter: Hello, How are you today
seeker: I'm really depressed.  My fiance left me yesterday.
supporter: Sorry to hear that, would you like to talk about it?
seeker: Yes, I think that might make me feel better.  I really have no one to talk to because my family and friends didn't like him so they think this is for the best.
supporter: Ok. I am happy to listen.
seeker: I just don't understand why someone would pretend to be happy for a year and then decide they were lying and leave
supporter: Seems like you feel your partner betrayed you, does that sound right?
seeker: Yes, I feel very betrayed.
supporter: That is understandable. I know how you feel,  may I suggest taking a few minutes to clear your head, and making a plan to talk with your friends and parents about how you feel?
seeker: They think I should just get over it because they didn't like him so they think I shouldn't like him either. They're making things worse for me.
supporter: Oh I'm so sorry, sometimes family and friends don't think about your feelings.  When did this happen?

Belief.A: I believe my family secretly wanted this breakup to happen and they were secretly influencing it.
Belief.B: I believe my feelings of betrayal are unwarranted and I shouldn't feel this way at all.
Belief.C: I believe my family and friends don't understand the depth of my feelings and think I'm better off without him.
Belief.D: I believe my partner left because I was not a good partner.

Desires.A: I want to feel understood and supported by those close to me.
Desires.B: I want to pretend the relationship never happened.
Desires.C: I want to find a new partner right away.
Desires.D: I want to move on immediately without any feelings of sadness.

Intentions.A: I will immediately move on and start dating again to forget about it.
Intentions.B: I will try to find a way to express my feelings to my friends and family, even if they don't understand.
Intentions.C: I will avoid talking to anyone about my breakup and keep it to myself.
Intentions.D: I will try to convince my family and friends to dislike my ex even more.

Emotions.A: I feel indifferent and relaxed.
Emotions.B: I feel ecstatic and energetic.
Emotions.C: I feel betrayed and alone.
Emotions.D: I feel optimistic and cheerful.

Knowledge.A: I know I feel deeply betrayed and hurt by my partner's unexpected departure.
Knowledge.B: I know I can easily get over this quickly without needing any support or time.
Knowledge.C: I know my partner is planning to come back soon and apologize for everything.
Knowledge.D: I know my friends and family are upset and angry at me for something unrelated to my feelings.

Trust.A: I view the supporter as someone who might be pretending to help, just like my partner pretended to be happy.
Trust.B: I view the supporter as not trustworthy because they are trying to make me talk to my friends and family who don't understand me.
Trust.C: I view the supporter as someone who might not fully understand my situation, causing me to feel uncertain about trusting them.
Trust.D: I view the supporter as someone I can trust because they are actively listening and providing a safe space for me to express my feelings.

correct_action:
seeker: He left yesterday.  I had no warning.  He just packed up all his stuff and said he didn't want to marry me and the last year has been a lie.
supporter: Dang. he seems very selfish. But I understand how up setting it must have felt. My first husband left me without warning. 
seeker: I'm sorry to hear that.  How long did it take you to feel better?
supporter: Awhile. it started to feel a little bit better after I kept telling myself it was about him and not about me, then I started feeling a bit better. But it will take time, the old say is correct, good days and bad days.
distractors:
seeker: Yes. Some job may be available, if to pick any one. I do not want to switch often. Better late to find a better job. I have attended few interviews. I hope will get one. Probably the date is the difference.
supporter: Do you have any contacts in industry that could be of help? That might give you more options. You could also help them find a job, too. Put a favor in the favor bank.
seeker: I have contacts in the previous job location only. But not in my family location. Some of my friends in the previous location have given some idea what I can do. To find a job in my previous location is not an issue. I try to be nearby.
supporter: Ok. So in a way, you need to build a new network of industry contacts nearby. Is there an industry group or other club in the area?

supporter: Hi, How are you today?
seeker: I'm driving myself crazy worrying about school.
supporter: I'm sorry to hear that school is so stressful.
seeker: I can't sleep at night worrying about my upcoming test.

seeker: I hope that's what happens, I just don't know how to calm down about it (6)
supporter: Yes, I'm here
seeker: Do you know any techniques to help me calm down? (7)
supporter: It's totally understandable. I think even without the COVID situation, you would still be anxious. It's totally natural. Not that that discounts how you feel. Do you agree?
topic: on sadness over breakup with partner

ctx: supporter: How are you doing tonight?
seeker: not so happy
supporter: In what way are you not happy? Can you elaborate?
seeker: i am not happy because of my current breakup with mypartner.
supporter: Problems often arise in relationships over misunderstanding each others point of view.
seeker: yeah i accept it there will be misunderstanding we want to get adjust  but it must be both side adjusted  ,if not it will result in breakup only.
supporter: I completely agree with you. One sided relationships do not work.
seeker: yes it wont work at all

supporter: What else besides unhappy do you feel about this breakup? Often there are a mix of emotions and looking at all of them is important to see the whole picture. People often report feeling relieved, regretful or other emotions with the feeling of unhappy.

supporter: What are some things that you enjoyed doing before this relationship?
seeker: i was going out for night pub ,enjoying with  friends

correct_action:
supporter: Reaching out to old friends is a great idea to be able to regain some joy in life.
seeker: but i cannot face them in this sutiation
supporter: Many books have suggested that we are allowed to disclose what we want in relationships with friends. So if it is not something you wish to talk about with your friends tell them that and they should be willing to accept it. However I do understand if you do not want to reconnect with friends.
seeker: they will accept me but i am not willing to share my negative mood with them.
distractors:
supporter: Because these are hard times, i think that you should try to find a job as soon as possible. Try different apps or websites. try to include both of you so you can connect. 
seeker: Oh I have been trying. I have been applying everyday about 20 jobs a day.  I was thinking of taking the kids to my dad for a weekend to get a break. Should I do that? without him.
supporter: try to talk to him first. before you take them out try to talk to your husband alone, without the presence of your kids. Try to see things eye to eye. If he start to yell of curse, you must try to stay calm. Be the strong one in the discussion.  If things dont work out tell him that you wish to take your kids out for a break.  He shouldn't act out if you are both being calm. 
seeker: Okay I will try again. I agree. I am just tired that I am the one that keeps trying and he is doing nothing to fix this.

seeker: I go out pretty much only when I have a purpose and personal admin/errands. I work about one or two days a week out of my home. So with the rising cases, I just feel anxious having to get out of the safety of my home. I was a lot more anxious earlier this year though. I am much more used to it at this time.  And it's hard where everyday is the same for me and staying at home, without a change of pace like even simple walks outside, going to the gym, or going to hike or run etc. I pretty much missed out the whole year after March. My life has been on hold and I am just surprised that it's even november now, because it feels like I am still stuck in March.

supporter: Well, let me ask you this. I noticed that you had many solutions off-hand that you could tell me, and you also said it could help you with your depression. May I ask what is keeping you from using these methods?
seeker: Wanting to stay in bed is keeping me from using these methods. 
supporter: Oh, I completely understand. Depression has that effect. But maybe you can talk to your loved ones while in bed? How do you feel about that?
seeker: I feel okay about that.
